resources.string: GameCube BIOS (IPL.bin) — optional. Pokémon XD runs fine without it. If you add one from your own GameCube, the GameCube startup animation plays before the game.

Choose your own Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness disc image (.iso, .gcm, .rvz, .ciso, .gcz, .wbfs). Dolphin XD remembers it, so you only do this once. Mods like Pokémon XG need the USA version as a full ISO.

Tap — A
Hold — B
Double-tap — Start
Tap, then tap and hold on the left half — L
Tap, then tap and hold on the right half — X
Swipe and keep your finger down — Control Stick, in any direction
Two-finger tap, then two-finger tap and hold — Dolphin menu

While one finger moves the stick, tap with another finger for A or hold it for B. Game controllers work too.
Dolphin couldn\'t read that file. Make sure it\'s a GameCube disc image of Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness.
That file is %1$s (%2$s), not Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness. Dolphin XD only plays Pokémon XD and mods of it.
That doesn\'t look like a GameCube BIOS. A BIOS dump is a 2 MB file usually called IPL.bin.
Dolphin XD couldn\'t read that file.
Your BIOS is from a different region than your copy of Pokémon XD, so the GameCube startup animation is skipped.
The GameCube BIOS couldn\'t be installed, so the startup animation is skipped.
The last game is still closing. Press Play again in a moment.
Two-finger tap, then tap and hold, opens the Dolphin menu.
%1$s can\'t be opened any more (moved, renamed or deleted?). Choose the game file again, or pick another version under Mods.
Wait for the current task to finish first.
Turn texture packs on or off without removing them.
Loads every texture when the game starts. Smoother, but needs a lot of memory and slows down booting — leave it off for big packs.

Choose the pack\'s .zip as you downloaded it. Both Dolphin texture packs (a GXX folder inside the zip) and Dolphin resource packs work; the importer puts the textures where Dolphin looks for Pokémon XD and turns on Load custom textures.\n\nFor the Pokémon XG/XD HD Texture Pack, use a PNG version on phones. DDS versions only show up on GPUs that support BC texture compression (most Snapdragon phones do, Mali/Exynos/Tensor GPUs don\'t).
The pack\'s textures are removed from this phone. You can import it again later.
%1$s is installed (%2$d textures). It shows up the next time you start the game.
\n\nThis pack uses DDS textures. If the game still looks the same, your GPU doesn\'t support them: delete this pack and import the PNG version instead.
No Dolphin textures were found. A texture pack contains files named like tex1_….png or tex1_….dds.
This pack is for a different game (%1$s), not Pokémon XD.
This zip can\'t be read here. Extract it with a file manager app, then use “Import extracted folder” and choose the GXX folder.
Not enough free space. This needs about %1$s free.
Your phone ran out of free space.

Mod patches are applied the way their instructions say: to a clean copy of your Pokémon XD disc image, which is never changed itself. For Pokémon XG: Next Gen, download the .ups patch from Project Pokémon and choose it here; it needs the USA version (GXXE01) as a full 1.46 GB ISO, but RVZ, GCZ and WIA copies of it are converted automatically.\n\nEach version keeps its own memory card saves and save states. Patching needs about 1.5 GB of free space.
The patched game is removed from this phone. Its saves are kept, so they come back if you install it again.
The game is removed from this list. The file itself stays where it is.
%1$s is installed and selected. Press Play to start it.
%1$s is added and selected. Press Play to start it.
Choose your Pokémon XD game file first.
That file isn\'t a UPS patch. Dolphin XD installs .ups patches like the one Pokémon XG: Next Gen comes with; for other formats, patch the game on a computer and use “Add already-patched game”.
Your game file is an NKit image (%1$s). Mod patches need the full, clean disc image: convert it back to a 1.46 GB ISO (for example with NKit\'s ConvertToISO) and choose that as your game file.
This patch doesn\'t match your game file (%1$s, %2$s). It was made for a clean disc image of exactly %3$s bytes; for Pokémon XG that\'s the USA version of Pokémon XD (GXXE01) as an untrimmed ISO.
The patch file seems to be damaged: %1$s. Download it again.
Your game couldn\'t be converted to an ISO.
The patched game can\'t be read by Dolphin.
